## Typical pricing
These are the ranges published on the site. Every job is quoted upfront before work begins.
- Drain cleaning: $150–$500 depending on severity
- Hydro jetting: $350–$600
- Sewer camera inspection: $150–$400
- Water heater installation: $1,200–$2,500 (tank), $2,500–$4,500 (tankless)
- Gas line repair: $150–$300; new gas line runs $500–$2,000
- Toilet and faucet work: $100–$250

## About
Family-run, licensed and insured. Free estimates, upfront pricing, and same-day service on most jobs. Jerrod Loewen purchased the company and continues its long-standing service to Chico and Butte County.
